tests.note: Completed test IDs are counted once across serial bounded batches. Two initial batch timeouts and two new-fixture errors are retained; the motion-array fixture was corrected before the 15 flight-condition cases passed. Only the no-airflow fixture changed afterward; that case and every unfinished test then passed. No production solver or acceptance threshold changed during these runs.

scope_audit.scope: Only sensor evaluation changed. Newton, continuation, full tangent, rank, one-sided stencils and thresholds retain identical function bodies (AST comparison ignores line locations).

ae2_output_parity.exclusion_reason: Counters, initialization descriptions and cancellation-sensitive one-sided slope diagnostics are not physical outputs; original full rank/smoothness gates remain independently enforced.
ae2_output_parity.timing_limit: One retained before/after run on the same host; load and startup vary. This is not a controlled repeated benchmark.

ae2_mesh.scope: Sensor RY=0.24 m is imposed, so its zero change is not an independent mesh check. Other changes are observations, without a newly selected pass threshold.

native_known_speed.independent_controls: Retained original 8/10 m/s solves; no reporting optimization applies to their unconstrained residuals.

custom_trim.scope: Local steady equations; dynamic and derivative responses release these trim constraints.
limitations: Expression units and constants are specified by the user; no dimensional inference or automatic unit conversion is applied.
Sensor structural quantities use the selected operator's reported one-sided load traces and declared strain/stress sampling; inspect the sensor sample location.
A locally regular equilibrium does not establish global uniqueness or stability. Refine mesh and finite-difference steps for sensitive constraints.
This original expression interface replaces custom GCON equations; arbitrary Fortran routines are not imported.

browser.exclusion_reason: Execution counters and cancellation-sensitive one-sided slope diagnostics are not physical quantities. The original smoothness and rank gates are checked independently.
